name: Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera
short_description: A 171-room 4-star hotel in the Alam Sutera district, between EMC Hospital and Living World Mall, about 350 meters from the mall on foot.
ai_summary: Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera is a 171-room, 4-star hotel at Jl Alam Sutera Boulevard Kav23 in Serpong, South Tangerang, positioned between EMC Hospital and Living World Shopping Mall in Alam Sutera's lifestyle and entertainment district. The property offers contemporary rooms, an outdoor pool, free bicycle rentals, a complimentary in-room minibar, and Mint & Pepper restaurant alongside Mocca cafe and the Maniz Pool Deck Bar. Soekarno-Hatta International Airport is about 14.7 km away, and Living World Mall sits roughly 350 meters on foot. Accor's own listing shows a 4.6/5 ALL rating from over 900 reviews, and numerous independent 2018-2025 YouTube reviews and TripAdvisor guests consistently praise it as a kid-friendly, well-located family staycation option, with only occasional mentions of the breakfast selection being less varied than at other Mercure properties.

faqs.question: How close is Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera to shopping and dining?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about 350 meters on foot from Living World Shopping Mall and roughly 200 meters from the Flavor Bliss dining district, placing guests within walking distance of Alam Sutera's main lifestyle and entertainment hub. Mall Alam Sutera is a further 3.3 km away by car.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- numerous independent YouTube reviews from 2018 through 2025 describe it as a strategically located, kid-friendly hotel, and Accor's own listing highlights free PS4 access at the lobby, a playground near the pool, and a special welcome drink for children as family-oriented touches.
